# Audit findings — `skills/objectui/` (objectui @ `origin/main` = `67dadd6`)

Read-only audit. Every span cited at the pinned ref. Token unit = `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`.

| Bytes | 256,089 |

### What is enforced in objectui, and what is not

| Gate | Scope | Covers `skills/**`? |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` + `scripts/skills-path-baseline.json` (`pnpm check:skills-paths`, CI `.github/workflows/skills-paths.yml:70`) | in-repo paths stated in backtick code spans in **prose** (not fences) exist on disk | **YES** — the only skills gate. Green: `92/93 stated path(s) resolve across 18 guide file(s); 1 baselined` |
| `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | `SCAN_ROOTS` (`:583-614`) — `content/docs`, `examples`, `docs`, package/app trees, root markdown | **NO** — there is no `skills` row |
| `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` | `DOCS_ROOT = 'content/docs'`; header states it verbatim: *"This gate walks `content/docs` and nothing else: not `skills/**`"* (`:211-213`) | **NO** |
| `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` | `DOCS_ROOT = 'content/docs'` + `PACKAGES_DIR` READMEs (`:301-302`) | **NO** |
| `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` | `content/docs` + `packages/PKGNAME/README.md` (`:144-145`) | **NO** |
| Token ratchet (objectstack `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) | — | **DOES NOT EXIST** in objectui. `package.json` has 60+ `check:*` scripts; none is a skills size/token gate. `skills/objectui/` has no ceiling and can grow without paying. |
| Example type-check (objectstack `packages/spec/scripts/check-skill-examples.ts`, marker `OSCHECK-MARKER` on the line above the fence) | — | **DOES NOT EXIST** in objectui. `grep -rc "os:check" skills/objectui/` → **zero markers**; all 123 TypeScript fences are unchecked by anything. |

Net: objectui enforces **path existence only**. Size, prose-vs-implementation drift, fence compilability and cross-package overlap are all unenforced.

**Structure check on `@object-ui/*` references (as instructed).** Every `import { … } from '@object-ui/*'` in a TypeScript fence resolves to a real package and a real export at `67dadd6` — verified for `app-shell`, `auth`, `components` (via `export * from './ui'` / `'./custom'`, `packages/components/src/index.ts:74-75`), `core`, `fields`, `i18n`, `mobile`, `permissions`, `providers`, `react`, `types`, `layout`. `@object-ui/mobile` (the 2026-08-31 sweep's site) **does** exist: `packages/mobile/package.json`, `private=no`. The remaining guides' package/export references are clean — the residue is elsewhere (OUI-F-02, OUI-H-01).
